# openwrt_firewall_rule (Resource)

Manages an OpenWrt firewall rule.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the firewall rule.
- `target` (String) Target action: 'ACCEPT', 'REJECT', 'DROP'.

### Optional

- `dest` (String) Destination zone name.
- `dest_ip` (String) Destination IP address or CIDR.
- `dest_port` (String) Destination port or range (e.g., '53', '80:443').
- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable or disable this rule.
- `extra` (String) Extra iptables options.
- `family` (String) IP family: 'ipv4', 'ipv6', or 'all'.
- `icmp_type` (List of String) ICMP type (e.g., ['echo-request', 'echo-reply']).
- `limit` (String) Rate limit (e.g., '1000/sec').
- `proto` (String) Protocol: 'tcp', 'udp', 'tcpudp', 'icmp', 'all'.
- `src` (String) Source zone name.
- `src_ip` (String) Source IP address or CIDR.
- `src_port` (String) Source port or range (e.g., '1024:65535').

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Internal ID: firewall/<rule_name>.
